SELECT MATERIAL_ID, DATEADD(day, -((DATEDIFF(day,'2026-09-30',SHIP_DT) % 28 + 28) % 28), SHIP_DT) AS dummy, COUNT(*) n FROM dbo.WHSLR_SHIP WHERE 1=0 GROUP BY MATERIAL_ID, SHIP_DT
